text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I'm feeling pretty good today. I think I
can handle
even more weight than usual!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh, I'm kinda out of it. Maybe I
should get
some fresh air...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Ah, what a nice breeze. It's nice and
quiet, and
the sun feels nice...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Listen to those birds,
singing like they've
not a
care in the world...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...I just can't be bothered today. Guess
I'll sleep.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Narita Brian soaks in the tranquil
atmosphere and
skips training.
